description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanReAmortizationValidator class in a financial software project, specifically testing various validation rules related to loan re-amortization operations.

classes.name: LoanReAmortizationValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for LoanReAmortizationValidator, verifying validation rules for loan re-amortization process, including date checks, loan status, schedule type, interest details, and previous transactions for correctness.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment before each test by setting thread-local context and tenant information.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldNotThrowException
methods.description: Tests successful validation when all conditions are met for re-amortization.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenExternalIdIsLongerThan100
methods.description: Checks that validation fails with an error if externalId exceeds 100 characters.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsAfterMaturity
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if re-amortization is attempted after the loan's maturity date.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsOnCumulativeSchedule
methods.description: Validates that re-amortization is unsupported for cumulative schedule type loans.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsNotOnAdvancedPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Checks that only loans with specific payment strategies support re-amortization.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsInterestBearing
methods.description: Validates that re-amortization is only supported for non-interest-bearing loans.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsNotActive
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the loan is not in active status.

methods.name: testValidateReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasReAmortizationForToday
methods.description: Prevents multiple re-amortizations on the same day.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanDoesntHaveReAmortization
methods.description: Validates that undo re-amortization is only applicable if a re-amortization exists.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAmortization
methods.description: Prevents undo if repayment has already occurred after re-amortization.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAmortize_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAmortization_SameDay
methods.description: Checks for repayments recorded after re-amortization on the same day, with specific timestamp considerations.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAmortize_ShouldNotThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAmortization_SameDay_RepaymentBeforeReAmortization
methods.description: Allows undo if repayment was before re-amortization on the same day.
